title: Unified Haptics and Audio Event Router
description:
Purpose: Centralize mapping of gameplay events to controller haptics and audio cues.

Behaviour:
- Subscribes to events emitted by other systems: "construct.preview", "construct.finalize", "construct.dismiss", "beam.start", "beam.stop", "block.hit", "recharge.progress", "recharge.complete", "flight.start", "flight.boost_on", "flight.boost_off", "impact.strong".
- Emits:
  - Haptics: light pulse (hover), sharp pulse (firing), heavy burst (finalize), rhythmic resonance (charge/beam), strong impact (block/collision), steady escalating (recharge).
  - Audio: plays from audio_sfx_music_pack matching events; spatialize to source entity where applicable.

Quest 3 bindings: none.

Components read/write:
- Reads event bus; writes CHapticCommand with pattern/duration/amplitude for left/right controllers; triggers audio events via CAudioCommand.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_haptics_profile: Confirm expected haptics patterns per interaction.

Assets/scenes: global; assets: audio_sfx_music_pack.
